item.title: Fast-moving grass fire caused Canada’s military base tragedy
item.description:
Prime minister Mark Carney describes blaze as ‘one of the worst tragedies for the forces on Canadian soil in peacetime’ Four people have been killed and dozens more seriously injured after a “violent, fast-moving” fire tore through one of Canada’s busiest military training bases in Alberta, the country’s prime minister said on Sunday. Mark Carney called the incident “one of the worst tragedies for the forces on Canadian soil in peacetime”. Continue reading...

item.title: Macron condemns violence after riots lead to looting and mass arrests
item.description:
Paris woke Sunday to shattered storefronts, burned cars and a heavy police presence after unrest swept through the city and other parts of France. Violent clashes broke out Saturday during nationwide demonstrations over rising living costs and poor school conditions. Hundreds of thousands marched across the country, while masked groups fought with police, looted businesses and set fires in several cities. Police reported 1,800 arrests nationwide, including 855 in the Paris region. VIOLENCE ERUPTS AT FRANCE PROTESTS AS MACRON WARNS UNREST IS BEING EXPLOITED The destruction was not limited to Paris. In Limoges, about three hours south of the capital, fire tore through the city’s historic town hall, built in 1883 and designated a historic landmark in 1975. item.title: Photographer attacked by settlers in the West Bank feels insulted by Netanyahu
item.description:
Left: Maryam Ghanem screams after an Israeli strike on Oct. 14, 2026. Photo via social media. Right: Maryam receives treatment at Al-Shifa Hospital on Oct. 15, 2026. Photo by Abdalhkem Abu Riash/Anadolu via Getty Images The video is haunting. Little Maryam, surrounded by fire and smoke , crying as she watches her mother burn. Maryam Ghanem survived, rescued by Palestinian journalist Ali al-Jaafrawi. The toddler is now an orphan. Her father was killed just months before she was born. She continues to ask for her mom. Maryam herself will forever be haunted by a genocide that she was born into – a genocide that took both of her parents and left her with severe burns. This is the reality children like Maryam face every day as the world continues to stand by as Israel kills, starves, burns. item.title: Bomb threat forces Israel to Austria flight into emergency landing
item.description:
An Austrian Airlines flight from Tel Aviv to Vienna made an emergency landing in Bulgaria after a bomb threat was reported near the Bulgarian-Romanian border. A MiG-29 fighter jet escorted the plane.

item.title: Brazil: Lula, Bolsonaro clash in heated presidential debate
item.description:
Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva and right-wing senator Flavio Bolsonaro traded personal attacks in a heated presidential debate on Sunday, a week before a closely contested run-off. The rivals accused each other of lying and corruption while clashing over the economy, security and healthcare ahead of the October 25 vote.

item.title: World Food Programme to end aid for half a million in Gaza due to funding shortfall
item.description:
The UN World Food Programme has warned that funding shortages will leave about 500,000 people in the Gaza Strip without critical food aid in a territory where two thirds of the population remains acutely food insecure. The WFP said it is reducing its monthly assistance from 1.6 million to 1.1 million people.

Covered by 2 public.
Sources: BBC News, France 24

item.title: ‘This is not poker’: Alberta goes to polls in referendum that has exposed divisions, not least among separatists
item.description:
